name: Driving harness
definition: the set of harness a horse, pony or donkey wears to draw a vehicle or implement: collar or breastplate, harness saddle, traces, breeching and reins.
reason: Saddlery for any animal (HS 4201); draws a load, so B10.4.1. Page must show a horse driving harness sold as a set.

name: Electronic pet fence
definition: a boundary-wire, wireless or GPS system that keeps a dog or cat inside a set area by signalling a receiver collar it wears.
reason: Pet-only containment is B10 (K-103 as gate, pen); sold for dogs and cats, rule 3.1. Page must show the system sold as one product.

name: Wet cat food
definition: a moist cat food in a can, pouch or tray.
reason: Memo: cat feed classes follow the dog classes (wet dog food B10.1.1.02). Page must show wet cat food sold.

name: Fresh or frozen cat food
definition: a lightly cooked or raw cat food kept chilled or frozen.
reason: Mirrors dog class B10.1.1.03 (memo; Pet Circle form split). Page must show chilled, fresh or frozen cat food sold.

name: Cat treat
definition: a snack fed to a cat apart from its meals; complementary, not a complete diet.
reason: Mirrors dog treat B10.1.1.06; AAFCO separates treats from complete foods. Page must show cat treats sold.

name: Compound horse feed
definition: a manufactured concentrate feed for horses: pellets, cubes, coarse mix or muesli; complete or complementary is an attribute.
reason: 'Complete' is the required feed attribute (memo §5), not the kind; new leaf B10.4.5. Page must show horse pellets or mixes.

name: Hoof care product
definition: an oil, balm, conditioner, packing or poultice applied to a horse's hoof.
reason: Sold as its own retail group (care leaf); hoof boots stay wear. Page must show a hoof product applied to horse hooves.

name: Horse supplement
definition: a nutritional supplement fed to a horse (joint, hoof, coat, digestive, electrolyte).
reason: Supplement is a feed class (memo §4b; AAFCO); horse-only, so B10.4.5. Page must show a supplement fed to horses.

name: Hay net
definition: a net or bag of rope or mesh that holds hay for a horse to pull from.
reason: Slow-feed small mesh is an attribute (C2(b)); new leaf B10.4.6. Page must show a hay net for horses.

name: Pet supplement
definition: a nutritional supplement for dogs or cats (joint, skin and coat, digestive, calming).
reason: Feed class (memo §4b); sold for dogs and cats, rule 3.1. Aggregator list: page must show a named pet supplement sold.

name: Pet shampoo or coat-care product
definition: a shampoo, conditioner, spray or wipe for cleaning a pet's coat and skin.
reason: Animal care is B10, not B6 (memo §9); dogs and cats, next free leaf B10.11.8. Page must show pet shampoo sold.

name: Varroa treatment
reason: Harvested bee-health products are mite treatments; a non-varroa bee medicine would widen the kind's wording, id unchanged.
Key step 12 (K-101): multi-colony robotic hive for commercial apiaries is C7. Provisional: if sold to hobby keepers, maker-bound named form of a hive kind.
